Development of hydel power
*441. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
develop maximum generation of hydel power
because it is more environment friendly and
also cost effective in the long run;
(b) what is the total capacity of hydel
power available in the country as on date;
and
(c) the details of Government's plan for
the next five years for development of
hydel power in different sectors, namely
public and private?
Power shortage in summer months
†*442. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that power
shortage in the country is likely to increase
in coming months;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether Government have also
assessed the demand and supply of power
in each State in the country for the coming
months of the current year; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Plant on renewable energy in
Jharkhand
*443. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have ever
started any plant on renewable energy in
Jharkhand;
(b) if so, the details thereof for the last
three years giving the location, district,
block and village-wise; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

139
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and by
when some plants of renewable energy will
be started in Jharkhand?
Programmes for welfare of SC/ST
*444. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) which are the programmes directly
concerning the welfare of SC and ST in the
National Common Minimum Programme
as approved by the U.P.A. Government;
(b) which out of the above are
implemented by Government as on the
31st March, 2007; and
(c) what action are taken by the
Ministry to implement the N.C.M.P. items
concerning to SC and other weaker sections
of the society?
Establishment of evening courts
*445. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have reviewed
the present work-load of pending cases in
the High Courts during the last two years,
State-wise and year-wise;
(b) whether Government have also
received any proposals from the State
Governments for establishing evening
courts to reduce the work-load as well as
for providing additional accommodation for
the sitting Judges in the High Courts;
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
such courts are likely to be set up;
(d) whether any funds would be
allocated for this purpose during the year
2007-08; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Central assistance for Tribal Sub-
Plan
*446. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Special Central Assistance
for the Tribal Sub-Plan has been extended
to States by the Centre as a 100 per cent
grant to fill critical gaps and missing inputs
for family-oriented income generating
schemes;
(b) whether any guidelines have been
issued in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Wage restructuring of Mini-
Anganwadi Centres
*447. SHRIMATI  BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the workers
and helpers of 36,829 Mini-Anganwadi
Centres are paid less than employees in
any other Anganwadi Centre;
(b) the total amount involved in this
differential wage structure from the Central
Government allocation; and
(c) whether Government plan to
upgrade the status of Mini-Anganwadi
Centres?

140
Money in lieu of SNP in Anganwadi
Centres
*448. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to provide money in lieu of Special
Nutrition Programme (SNP) in Anganwadi
Centres;
(b) whether Government have asked the
Anganwadi Workers to open bank accounts
alongwith President/Secretary of Mothers'
Committee;
(c) whether the new scheme has already
been implemented in a few States; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Reduction in allocations for
universities

Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE

(a) whether the University Grants
Commission (UGC) has reduced allocations
for universities with a high percentage of
minority students;
(b) whether it is a fact that UGC has
not adopted a fair approach towards
religious minorities;

Total number of questions — 155
776
Institutions on oceanography in the
country
3347. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of institutions/colleges
set up in the country on oceanography,
State-wise and since when;
(b) the length of the Eastern and Western
coastal lines;
(c) whether some more institutions/
colleges are to be set up; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Proposal for Tsunami Warning
Centres
3348. SHRI K.P.K. KUMARAN: Will
the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal under its consideration to
establish some more Tsunami Warning
Centres other than the ones already selected
under Phase-I, namely Chennai, Cuddalore,
Nagapattinam, Rameswaram, Tuticorin and
Kanyakumari; and
(b) whether Government will take into
consideration a new idea of establishing Sub-
Centres in between these six Centres since
the distance between these Centres is feared
to be too large?
 Food testing laboratories in the
country
3349. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of food testing
laboratories in the country at present;
(b) whether Government propose to set
up more such laboratories and if so, the
details thereof, State-wise; and
(c) by when, these laboratories will start
functioning?

777
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 Status of food processing industries
in U.P.
3350. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of food processing
industries functioning at present in Uttar
Pradesh and the financial assistance given
to them during the last three years;
(b) whether much export has been made
by these industries during that period
alongwith the foreign exchange earned by
them;
(c) whether Government propose to
provide more financial assistance to them
to enable them to compete in the
international market; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Utilization of funds
3351. SHRI SHARAD ANANTRAO
JOSHI: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
was able, during the first four years of the
Tenth Five Year Plan, to use only Rs. 361
crores out of an amount of Rs. 2,800 crores
allotted;
(b) whether it is also a fact that his
Ministry in their explanation for under
utilization of the funds had accepted that
they had no projects; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that a large
number of  NASA and food processing units
have been put to serious trouble because
his Ministry did not use the funds?
 Establishment of mega food parks
†3352. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of various steps being
taken to establish the mega food parks in
different States;
(b) whether the process of setting up
mega food parks has already been initiated
in some States; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
 Expansion of food processing
industries in Karnataka
3353. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES
be pleased to state:
(a) the schemes for the expansion of
Food Processing Industries in the State of
Karnataka which are presently in the
process of execution, scheme-wise;
(b) by when each one is likely to be
completed; and
(c) the reasons for delay for those
pending for over one year after the time
stipulated for completion?
 Supreme Court's stay on reservation
3354. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court has
stayed the law providing 27 per cent
reservation for OBCs in higher education;
(b) if so, whether the verdict cause
impediments in the prospects of higher
education for the OBC sections;

778
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether Government are
Contemplating constitutional measures for
the implementation of the 93rd
Amendment; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 RTI Act in school curriculum
3355. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposed the
inclusion of the Right to Information (RTI)
Act as a subject in school curriculum in all
Government and public/private schools of
the country;
(b) if so, the steps being taken or
proposed to be taken by Government in
this respect; and
(c) the time-frame within which it is
likely to be implemented in school text
books?
 Representation from Teacher
